ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: From the food web diagram, if all the squid die, dolphin numbers would _____.
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The image shows a marine food web, with dolphins labeled on the left, squid labeled at the lower left, fish on the right, seabirds above, and plankton at the lower right. It can be seen that there is an arrow from near squid pointing to dolphins, indicating that squid is one of the food sources for dolphins. Reasoning: Arrows in the food web indicate that energy flows from the organism being eaten to the predator. If all squid died, dolphins would lose one food source, therefore dolphin numbers would decrease.
